interactive.label: Open burst folder
interactive.tooltip: Select the burst-analysis folder containing bi4_bur.

interactive.label: MMFDB datasets
interactive.tooltip: Resolve an existing burst analysis from the database.

interactive.label: Load settings
interactive.tooltip: Load a saved fusion parameter JSON file.

interactive.label: Save settings
interactive.tooltip: Save current fusion parameters as JSON.

interactive.label: Export fusion report
interactive.tooltip: Export before/after statistics and the output folder path.

interactive.label: fusion_type
interactive.tooltip: Use auto for header detection or specify SPC-130, PTU, HT3 or HDF; a source manifest takes precedence.

interactive.label: Detector definitions
interactive.tooltip: Define detector routing and PIE windows when a legacy source folder has no reading manifest.

interactive.label: Stop fusion
interactive.tooltip: Cancel the estimate before writing; an output write already started finishes consistently.

interactive.label: folder
interactive.tooltip: The burst-analysis folder to fuse — the output of burst selection. Nothing in it is modified; the fused bursts go to a new folder beside it.

interactive.label: threshold
interactive.tooltip: Two consecutive bursts are fused while the probability that they are the same molecule is at least this. 1 fuses nothing; low values eventually merge different molecules.

interactive.label: max_gap_ms
interactive.tooltip: Ceiling on the gap fusion may bridge, whatever the probability says (0 removes it). A fused burst is one interval on disk, so bridging a gap puts its background photons inside the burst.

interactive.label: max_group
interactive.tooltip: Largest number of original bursts one fused burst may contain (0 = no limit). Caps runaway chains in dense data.

interactive.label: 🚀 Run (Fuse)
interactive.tooltip: Fuse burst fragments that likely belong to the same molecule using the P(same) threshold.

interactive.label: 🔄 Estimate
interactive.tooltip: Estimate the P(same) curve and thresholds from the loaded bursts without fusing.

interactive.label: 🧪 Demo
interactive.tooltip: Load a demo dataset to try the fusion analysis.

interactive.label: 📖 Guide
interactive.tooltip: Start a step-by-step guided tour of this tool.

interactive.label: ❓ Help
interactive.tooltip: Open the help window with reference documentation.

interactive.label: tau_min_ms
interactive.tooltip: Shortest inter-burst lag the correlation is evaluated at.

interactive.label: tau_max_ms
interactive.tooltip: Longest lag evaluated. A threshold the curve never falls below inside this range leaves the window unresolved.

interactive.label: n_bins
interactive.tooltip: Logarithmic lag bins between the shortest and longest lag.

interactive.label: min_pairs
interactive.tooltip: Burst pairs a lag bin needs before it may end the fusion window. Stops a hole in sparse statistics reading as a confident 'different molecule'.

interactive.label: Pool files
interactive.tooltip: Estimate one curve from every measurement of the folder (lags always stay inside a measurement). A single short file rarely has enough burst pairs on its own.

interactive.label: Record grouping
interactive.tooltip: Write an fg4 companion beside the original bursts giving each one its fused-burst number, so the grouping can be inspected or gated on there.

interactive.label: All plots
interactive.tooltip: Show the all plots before/after comparison.
